notes.title: Virtual Cartridge Update
notes.notes:
This update introduces Virtual Cartridges: A whole new way to share & play custom decks!

Virtual Cartridges are special images that let you share your custom decks over social media or in your group chats. Pop one in from the main menu to play with custom content, or share your custom decks by right-clicking each title in the Deck Editor and selecting Share Virtual Cartridge.

This update also improves the Deck Editor by adding support for up to eight options on each card and version tracking for custom decks.

Thanks for playing Impeached 2!

notes.title: Graphical Update
notes.notes:
This update brings more dynamic graphics, and transforms Capitol Hill based on your actions!

Watch a crowd form to protest unpopular decisions, or foreign enemies increasing their military presence.

Also brings some minor bug fixes & improvements.

Thanks for playing Impeached 2!

notes.title: Bribery Update!
notes.notes:
This update gives you more freedom to get things done the way you want!

Need to pass a critical law, but Congress is blocking it? You can now bribe members of both parties to raise support!

Also brings some minor bug fixes.

Thanks for playing Impeached 2!
